{{Quote|Sir, I'm reading another ship emerging from hyperspace.''"<br />"''Another--? We weren't expecting any more arrivals...!|An officer and Trask|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Starcrusher Trap">''[[The Clone Wars: The Starcrusher Trap]]''</ref>}}
'''Trask''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] who was killed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]'' around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Trask was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he led a naval task force of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] against a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Unidentified munitions factory|munitions factory]] located on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] deep within enemy space.

As the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sabotaged the factory's [[Force field/Legends|force field]], the task force was assaulted by the Separatist [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]''. Trask ordered [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] to be raised, but this didn't stop the ''Starcrusher'' from destroying his ship and task force, killing the captain and his crew.
